candidate_decisions.reason: The native focus supplies exact carriers for the water-access, entry, opening, clear-road, forward-racing, and return branches, and the neighboring focus words independently connect them into a routed movement toward good with one return. The contact materially changes the reading of differentiated ways without replacing the plain legal reading.

The exact HFT trace identifies supplied 5:44 context coordinates at words 17 and 23 and returns through the supplied 5:48 supervisory and confirming terms. The unresolved context records are retained as attributed evidence, while the focus branch descriptors and their relevant facets are copied without adding an un supplied lexical gloss.

The exact HFT trace agrees with the supplied 5:41 word coordinates for deflection, meaningful words, and placement, and returns through the focus language of revelation, truth, and oversight. The registered focus facets support the positional reading; unresolved context branches remain explicitly attributed and are not given invented glosses.

The exact HFT trace supplies two speed occurrences around the focus, the inner condition of illness, and the feared adverse turn, while the focus supplies racing and good as distinct carriers. Their contact changes the object and fruit of urgency, so the candidate survives as attributed contextual evidence.

findings.title: Differentiated ways become traversable routes
findings.claim: The focus presents each assigned شرعة and منهاج as a route that can be entered, opened, and followed, then directs its travelers into forward movement toward good while keeping their return to God in view.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier شِرْعَة is supplied with water-access, entering, and path-opening facets; مِنْهَاج supplies the clear-road contact; ٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ supplies directed movement; and مَرْجِعُكُمْ supplies the common return. These contacts turn differentiated ways into a connected route image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the assigned ways as usable passages with direction and destination, while the plain statement about distinct communities and good works remains intact.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains that God gives communities distinct ways, tests them through what He gives, commands good works, and will disclose their disagreements. The watercourse and road relation is a local focus reading, not a claim that the words lose their ordinary legal meanings.

epistemic.reason: All six carriers are registered focus branches with exact focus occurrences, and the trusted nomination supplies the connecting route relation and its changed reading.

findings.title: Oversight continues entrusted preservation
findings.claim: The focus term مُهَيْمِنًا can be read, within the supplied pericope contact, as accountable oversight continuous with preserving the earlier Book and bearing witness to it, while مُصَدِّقًا makes that custody an active verification.
findings.mechanism: The supplied 5:44 context coordinates for sustained guarding and witnessing meet the focus occurrence مُهَيْمِنًا; the focus occurrence مُصَدِّقًا supplies verification of an earlier record. Their contact joins preservation, witness, and confirmation in the focus Book's supervisory role.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees oversight as a responsible relation to an inherited record: the Book watches over it and confirms it, rather than the focus term remaining a flat label for authority.
findings.containment: The plain reading remains that the Book was sent in truth, confirms what preceded it, oversees it, and supplies the basis for judgment. The custody relation is attributed to the supplied contextual trace and does not settle every broader meaning of supremacy or replacement.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch facets are supplied, but the 5:44 carriers and their branch identities are legacy-attributed and unresolved in the branch registry; the exact coordinates and focus return are nevertheless present.

findings.title: Good redirects anxious haste
findings.claim: The focus imperative to race toward good redirects the pericope's supplied scenes of rapid movement: urgency is given a different object and fruit from the haste driven by distortion, illness, or fear of an adverse turn.
findings.mechanism: The exact 5:41 and 5:52 speed coordinates bracket the focus, with the latter joined to inner illness and a feared reversal. The focus carriers ٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ and ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ preserve forward urgency while changing its direction and object.
findings.reader_payoff: The command becomes a measure for urgency itself: movement matters by where it goes and what it produces, not by speed alone.
findings.containment: The plain focus command remains a call to race toward good. The surrounding speed contrast is an attributed contextual reading; it does not claim that every occurrence of speed has one fixed meaning or that the focus is about defeating another community.

epistemic.reason: The HFT supplies exact context coordinates, focus carriers, and the changed-reading mechanism, but its branch registry identity is unresolved and its reader identity is legacy-unbound.

branch_activations.activation: The illness carrier meets the good criterion, distinguishing a diseased rush from movement whose object is good.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's good is perceptible as the criterion that gives urgency a sound direction.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the attributed inner-condition role is used; no clinical or independent lexical claim is added.

findings.title: The route meets provision
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:2 occurrence of Rabb gives the focus's open water-access facet a provision-shaped contact: the route can be perceived as an access point through which what the Sustainer gives reaches communities.
findings.mechanism: The external 1:2 root occurrence for رَبِّ is supplied with nurture and abundant-water cues, while the focus occurrence شِرْعَة has the registered open water-access facet. The external sustaining trigger adds a source-and-provision relation to the native route image.
findings.reader_payoff: The water image gains an agent and a practical consequence: a way is not only open, it is where provision can reach those who receive it.
findings.containment: The focus still says that distinct communities are given distinct ways and methods and are tested by what they receive. The added provision relation does not redefine شرعة as provision, activate every external cue, or merge the communities' ways.

epistemic.reason: The external occurrence and its compact branch-image cues are supplied, and the focus carrier and facet are registered; the external context has no full branch descriptor or independent support record.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: açık su alma yeri ve oraya girip içme

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The external 1:2 occurrence رَبِّ is supplied with nurture and abundant-water cues.
branch_activations.activation: The sustaining trigger meets the focus water-access carrier and adds provision as the relation through which the open route matters.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The differentiated way can be pictured as a provision-reaching access point under the Sustainer's care.
branch_activations.boundary: The external cue is used only as a trigger for this focus facet; no external branch gloss is invented and شرعة is not equated with Rabb.

findings.title: The clear way becomes a guided road
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa path wording makes the focus occurrence مِنْهَاجًا perceptible as a marked road that is made clear, approached under guidance, and followed, while the focus still retains distinct ways for distinct communities.
findings.mechanism: The external cues at 1:2, 1:4, 1:5, 1:6, and 1:7 supply signs, a leading guide, treading or leveling, and repeated straight-road occurrences. These triggers meet the focus clear-road branch and its registered making-visible and following facets, adding guided traversability beyond the native road image.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees method as a course one can recognize and follow with guidance, so the focus's ways become lived routes rather than only classifications.
findings.containment: The focus's ordinary claim about distinct شرعة and منهاج remains present. This is an overlay from the individually supplied Fātiḥa occurrences; it does not say that every path cue is active, that all routes become one earthly route, or that the focus is reduced to a prayer for guidance.

epistemic.reason: The exact external occurrences and compact branch-image cues are present, and the focus clear-road branch is registered. The external members provide no full branch descriptors or separate support records, so the overlay remains qualified.
